title: 修复 Release 工作流 Code Scanning 告警
rawUserRequest: 查看 Code Scanning 的三个问题；确认先修复再判断是否需要发布新版本，并同意采用保留现有发布语义、收紧信任边界的方案。

declaredIntent.summary: 修复 Release workflow 中 CodeQL 标记的 artifact poisoning 与 environment variable injection 数据流。

outOfScope: GitHub release, tag, or asset publication
Changes to the smoke workflow or release metadata values
Dismissal or suppression of CodeQL alerts without a remediation

sources.reason: Contains the alerted artifact-download and environment-export data flows.
Capability Truth evidence binds the release workflow to independent CI and artifact evidence requirements.

riskAssessment.reason: The workflow controls release evidence and has write permissions; changes are constrained to fail-closed validation and regression tests.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: User approved the scoped remediation design; publication remains explicitly out of scope.

preReviewWarnings: Review the artifact provenance binding, fail-closed parsing, and whether the rewritten flow eliminates CodeQL findings without weakening release checks.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The release workflow rejects untrusted or malformed rehearsal and strict-smoke identifiers before artifact retrieval or environment export.
Artifact evidence used by publication remains bound to the expected same-source rehearsal and strict-smoke runs, with fail-closed validation.
The CodeQL environment-variable injection flow is removed without alert suppression.
Focused workflow regression tests cover the new trust-boundary assertions and pass.
The design record documents the selected approach and excludes release publication.
guidelines: Do not weaken release integrity checks or bypass CodeQL findings.
Keep changes limited to the declared release workflow, focused regression tests, and design record.

intent.problem: CodeQL reports two artifact-poisoning flows and one environment-variable injection flow in the release workflow, where workflow-dispatch input and downloaded receipt data cross the trust boundary.
constraints: Fail closed on malformed or mismatched evidence.
Do not publish a release or mutate tags as part of this Work Item.
Do not dismiss or suppress alerts in place of a fix.
intent.rationale: Validation and data-flow hardening protect the existing release design while keeping the change narrowly reviewable.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A publication run references a malformed rehearsal run identifier.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The workflow rejects it before downloading an artifact.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused workflow regression test checks numeric identifier validation precedes artifact download.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A receipt contains a malformed strict smoke run identifier or an unexpected artifact name.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The workflow rejects the receipt and never exports an unvalidated value to GITHUB_ENV.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused workflow regression test checks strict validation and safe propagation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A valid exact-source rehearsal is reused for publication.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Existing source, workflow, event, artifact digest, and evidence checks remain fail-closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused workflow regression test and project quality suite.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized completion of this Work Item after approving the remediation design.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
